rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent mass across the views, with a single dominant carved-and-bent block rather than fragmented parts. It responds to the parcel in a broad way and stays inside the boundary, but the gesture is somewhat over-staircased/terraced and the public void at the access edge is not especially forceful. The blue access edge is acknowledged only weakly: there is no clearly legible entry court, undercut, or active threshold opening toward it. Programmatically, it can plausibly support neighborhood living/commercial use as an early-stage mass, but the section logic is still close to a generic extruded-and-bent object and does not yet fully express the required active ground/public threshold relationship. Reference 1042657 is the best massing analogue for carved compact hierarchy; the restaurant/courtyard references support a public void principle; the bridge reference is useful only as a counterfactual entry-seam idea.
